Bug_Title: Synchronization should not be done on instances of value-based classes
Bug_Explanation: This code demonstrates a synchronization bug by synchronizing on instances of a value-based class, specifically the Integer class. Both 'a' and 'b' are Integer objects that may reference the same object in memory, leading to unintended synchronization behavior.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases call the 'showBug' method with both 0 and 1. This triggers the synchronization bug by synchronizing on Integer instances 'a' and 'b', which are value-based classes. The bug occurs because both 'a' and 'b' may refer to the same object in memory, leading to unintended synchronization behavior and potential deadlocks.
